targets.statement: The manual's hand-signal chart covers three maneuvers when turn indicators fail: a left turn, slowing or stopping, and a right turn.

targets.statement: A child starting to run into the street is given as an example of sounding the horn when a pedestrian may not see your vehicle.

targets.statement: When an oncoming vehicle and a bicyclist ahead coincide, handle one condition at a time by slowing behind the cyclist until oncoming traffic passes.
